zh: 桥上最多同时两辆车，而且车辆按原队列顺序上桥，所以真正的约束只是：每辆保留的车自身不超重，以及每对相邻的保留车重量和不超过 U。
从左到右扫描，只需记住最后一辆保留车的重量。新车若与它冲突，两辆中至少要删一辆；留下较轻的那辆作为末车，对后续所有车辆都不会更差。
维护 last（最后保留车的重量，初始为空）和删除计数 answer；对每辆车 v：若 v > U，直接删除并计数；否则若 last 为空或 last + v ≤ U，就保留它并令 last = v；否则计数加一，并令 last = min(last, v)；最后输出 answer。
en: At most two vehicles are on the bridge at once and they enter in queue order, so the real constraints are just: every kept vehicle is not overweight by itself, and every pair of adjacent kept vehicles weighs at most U in total.

Scan from left to right and remember only the weight of the last kept vehicle. If a new vehicle conflicts with it, at least one of the two must go; keeping the lighter one as the last vehicle is never worse for any later vehicle.

Keep last (the weight of the last kept vehicle, initially none) and a removal count answer; for each vehicle v: if v > U, remove it and count it; otherwise, if last is none or last + v <= U, keep it and set last = v; otherwise increment the count and set last = min(last, v); print answer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Keep track of the last vehicle of the kept sequence; if the new vehicle overloads the bridge together with it, remove the heavier of the two. A vehicle that is overweight by itself is removed directly.

## Proof of correctness

A valid kept sequence requires exactly that no single vehicle is overweight and every pair of adjacent kept vehicles weighs at most U. At least one of two conflicting vehicles must be removed, and keeping the lighter one as the last vehicle is never worse for any future vehicle, while it does not break any earlier adjacency constraint. An exchange argument shows that each step preserves both the optimal count and the most favorable last vehicle.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) space apart from the input.
